# Primitives

The raw values of Dense data. Primitives hold the values; semantic tokens give them a job (see [Foundations](../foundations/index.md)), and components read only the jobs.

**113** primitives. **77** are used by a semantic token, a theme or a component key. **36** are not used yet: they stay, so a brand or a changed answer can use them without adding a value.

| [Space and size](./space-and-size.md) | 9 | 8 |
